message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features the large gray title "TEMPO" above the text "PARA PENCURI KITAB TUHAN" in bold black. Below, smaller text reads: "Proyek pengadaan Al-Quran Kementerian Agama berlumur korupsi. Betulkah Wakil Menteri Nasaruddin Umar ditekan?". The date "EDISI 2-8 JULI 2012" is visible under the main title.

The central illustration depicts a stack of numerous greenish-blue 20,000-denomination Indonesian Rupiah banknotes resting on an open wooden book stand, or rehal. The banknotes are folded and piled high, mimicking the shape of an open book. The wooden stand is dark brown with carved legs and sits on a light gray surface against a gradient white-to-light-blue background.

The top banner includes three headlines: "Jaksa Marwan vs Tuduhan Twitter", "Dahlan Iskan dan Politik Istana" accompanied by a small portrait of a smiling man in glasses, and "Ramai-ramai Sawer Gedung KPK". The bottom left corner shows the price "RP 29.700", a website, a barcode, and the serial number "00018". A red vertical band runs along the left edge.
